evidence_text: Environment Agency LIDAR Composite DSM 1m metadata: 1 m raster digital surface model containing terrain and surface objects; GeoTIFF rasters in 5 km tiles aligned to the OS National Grid; EPSG:27700; metres referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn using OSTN15; vertical accuracy +/-0.15 m RMSE; 2022 composite built from surveys dated 2000-06-06 through 2022-04-02; creation 2023-02-08; revision 2023-12-15; Open Government Licence; no public access constraints. Height-difference calculation remains local-only.
